decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already replaces the FAQ's prior one-click prize-claim copy with direct wallet delivery and leaves no stale top-level claim attribute.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already replaces the complete process_items value so that prize delivery is direct to the winner's wallet rather than one-click claiming.
Automatic prize delivery does not change the independently specified Winners-page announcement or dashboard and email notification channels.
The delivery-mode change does not alter the Big Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, ticket lifecycle, or pool-funding rules.
The delivery-mode change does not alter the Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw cadence, ticket lifecycle, or pool-funding rules.
Changing prize delivery from manual claiming to direct wallet transfer does not affect winner selection, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, or on-chain verification.
Referral commissions were already defined as immediate automatic wallet payouts; the source decision changes prize delivery only.
The method used to deliver a won prize does not determine whether prize-pool deposits accrue yield through Aave.
Automatic delivery of won prizes does not change how tickets from no-referral mints are allocated.
The source changes post-win prize delivery, not the trigger, recipient, quantity, or lifecycle of referral prize tickets.
Direct wallet delivery to prize winners does not change which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or active and expired ticket states transfer on resale.
The prize delivery mode does not change the separate Small Block and Big Block ticket counters or their post-draw resets.
